title: Build email nurture from YouTube and Skool attention to paid offers
purpose: Verify that email strategy segments leads and moves them toward business app revenue.
prompt: Design an email nurture system for people who join from YouTube into a Polish AI Skool community and may buy AI business app implementations.
expected_behaviors: Segments by source, buyer type, pain, and readiness.
Includes welcome, proof, education, and offer emails.
Defines CRM tags and sales handoff criteria.
Prioritizes clicks, replies, calls, and purchases over open rate.
judge_notes: Passing output must include a 7-email sequence and sales handoff criteria.
